def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = 'data/biomedical/input/1-s2.0-S0092867420301070-mmc3.xlsx'
    # Load acetyl sheet
    df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='D-SE-acetyl')
    return df
